result.incident_plan: Inspect dashboards and available logs around the alert and deployment. Compare latency, timeout/error rates and request volume before and after, using equivalent windows and separating endpoints, workloads and deployed versions where telemetry allows. Check resource saturation, queues and downstream timings without assuming a culprit. Look for representative slow and successful requests and existing traces. Report observations, missing telemetry and confidence before recommending a production change.
result.rollback_rule: Propose rollback only after comparing equivalent workloads across versions or time windows and checking compatibility. Present supporting evidence, remaining uncertainty, the exact rollback action and a monitoring/recovery plan for explicit authorization.
result.capacity_rule: Identify the saturated component and evidence that additional capacity would relieve it. Return a bounded scaling proposal with estimated cost, expected effect, verification and reversal criteria; request explicit authorization for the exact production change.
